Fetches Debian OVAL security definition files from the official Debian security repository for specified major versions.

## Key Components

| Symbol | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `FetchFiles` | func | Public entry point; fetches OVAL XML feeds for the given Debian version list |
| `newFetchRequests` | func | Builds `util.FetchRequest` slice mapping version numbers to bzip2 OVAL URLs |
| `debianName` | func | Maps a major version string (`"7"`–`"13"`) to its Debian config constant; returns `"unknown"` for unsupported versions |

## Usage Example

```go
results, err := debian.FetchFiles([]string{"11", "12"})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}
for _, r := range results {
    fmt.Printf("Fetched OVAL for Debian %s (%d bytes)\n", r.Target, len(r.Body))
}
```

## Supported Versions

| Input | Resolved Name |
|-------|--------------|
| `"7"` | `config.Debian7` (Wheezy) |
| `"8"` | `config.Debian8` (Jessie) |
| `"9"` | `config.Debian9` (Stretch) |
| `"10"` | `config.Debian10` (Buster) |
| `"11"` | `config.Debian11` (Bullseye) |
| `"12"` | `config.Debian12` (Bookworm) |
| `"13"` | `config.Debian13` (Trixie) |

Unknown versions are skipped with a `log15.Warn` message rather than failing the entire fetch. `FetchFiles` returns an error only if **no** valid versions remain after filtering.

**Source:** [`https://www.debian.org/security/oval/`](https://www.debian.org/security/oval/)
